def solve(g):

    rs=[p[0] for p in pos]; cs=[p[1] for p in pos]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    key=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=fc_ and not(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c1)]
    inside=defaultdict(set)

    sub=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    cand=set()
    for (mr,mc,mcol) in key:

        if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and O[rr][cc]==bg: O[rr][cc]=col
    return O,best

def try_solve(g,o=None):
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg,bg_=frames(g)
    k,r0,r1,c0,c1=fg[0]; H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    inside=defaultdict(set)
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v!=bg and v!=k: inside[v].add((r-r0,c-c0))
    objs=[]
    for col,s in inside.items():
        rs={a for a,b in s}; cs={b for a,b in s}
        objs.append((col,len(s),(max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs)-min(cs)+1)))
    # tile: per color bbox; fallback mode
    tiles={}
    for col,ns,(bh,bw) in objs: tiles[col]=(bh,bw)
    def tile(col): return tiles.get(col,tiles[sorted(tiles)[0]])
    outcells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0]))
              if not(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1) and g[r][c]!=bg]
    O=[[g[r0+i][c0+j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    best=(-float('inf'),None)
    for off in itertools.product(range(-len(O)+1,len(O)), repeat=2):
        good=True; nm=0; bad=0
        for (mr,mc,col) in outcells:
            br,bc=mr+off[0],mc+off[1]
            bh,bw=tile(col)
            for dr in range(bh):
                for dc in range(bw):
                    rr,cc=br+dr,bc+dc
                    if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W): good=False;break
                    if O[rr][cc]==col: nm+=1
                    elif O[rr][cc]==bg: O[rr][cc]=col; nm+=1
                    else: bad+=1
                if not good: break
            if not good: break
        if not good: continue
        sc=(nm,bad,off)
        if sc>best[0]: best=sc
    return best,O
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:

# Stop flailing. Rewrite cleanly: find ALL cells whose color appears in BOTH inside and outside; the object OUTSIDE
# is the SAME shape in miniature. Find transformation (scale, translation) mapping outside object's cells to
# corresponding inside cells; apply to produce final output = inside crop.
def try_solve(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg,bg_=frames(g)
    k,r0,r1,c0,c1=fg[0]; H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    inside=defaultdict(set)
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v!=bg and v!=k: inside[v].add((r-r0,c-c0))
    outcells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0]))
              if not(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c1) and g[r][c]!=bg]
    # candidate mappings: for each pair (out cell, inside cell) with same color compute scale as ratio of bbox dims
    best=None
    for mr,mc,col in outcells:
        si=list(inside.get(col,{}))
